title: Add details to project sales tooltip
summary: Project Sales by Project chart now displays project description and customer name in the tooltip alongside the project number to help users identify projects and customers without reducing visual readability.
key_points: Adds Project Description and Customer Name to the tooltip of the Project Sales by Project visual
Keeps Project No. as the compact chart axis so labels stay readable
Updates the Jobs query and the Project table of the Sales semantic model along with the visual definition
Chart axis, measures, sorting and filters are unchanged
